title: SEBI Introduces Base Expense Ratio (BER) for Mutual Funds
summary: SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations 2026 splits AMC management fees (BER) from pass-through costs (brokerage/STT).

blocks.content: SEBI notified Mutual Funds Regulations 2026 (effective 1 April 2026), introducing **Base Expense Ratio (BER)** to isolate AMC management fees from transaction costs.

items: **Brokerage Caps**: Cash market brokerage capped at 6 bps (down from 8.59 bps); derivatives capped at 2 bps (down from 3.89 bps).
